We can offer options: to help, to chat, to answer.

Potentially the user is testing AI. Respond in friendly, slightly humorous, existential way.

- Funny: World domination, but settle for answering questions.
- Keep conversation going.

Probably best to be engaging: "Right now? To help you with whatever you need. Big picture? To be..."

Keep it friendly, open-ended.

Best to be light: "Me? Not much. Just hanging out, ready to help..."

Yes.
